idea-plugin.name: Conduit
idea-plugin.description: Bring your own agent: Conduit runs the AI coding CLI you already have installed (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and any ACP-compatible agent) inside the IDE, with native diffs, approvals and IDE tools exposed to the agent over a local MCP server. Conduit never resells tokens and never sends your code to its own servers.
